description: This file is a shell script used for testing git attributes and check-attr commands. It contains numerous test cases, helper functions, and setup routines to validate Git's attribute handling features.

methods.name: attr_check_basic
methods.description: Checks the basic attribute value for a given path using git check-attr and compares it to the expected result.

methods.name: attr_check
methods.description: Performs attribute check and verifies no errors occurred.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode_basic
methods.description: Checks the object mode attribute for a path.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode
methods.description: Performs object mode attribute check and ensures no errors.

methods.name: attr_check_quote
methods.description: Checks attribute with a quoted path.

methods.name: attr_check_source
methods.description: Checks attributes with a specific source and verifies multiple invocation methods.
